source: Virtual Fly Brain VFBquery HTTP API (https://v3-cached.virtualflybrain.org/), FlyWire FAFB v783 connectome; class-aggregated /query_connectivity, edge weight = total synapse count

behavior.text: Egg laying: oviposition descending neurons (oviDNs) command the abdominal motor circuits that drive ovipositor movements and egg deposition.
behavior.basis: textbook Drosophila oviposition circuit (oviDNs -> abdominal/VNC motor); stated as known biology

honest_note: EGG-LAYING DRIVE wiring: oviDN (FBbt_00049919, the 12-instance aggregate class of oviDNa/b/d/v/x) -> VNC/abdominal motor populations + ascending leg-to-brain-style feedback + SEZ output. The motor end (efferent/motor neurons at hop 2) is the ovipositor/abdominal muscle command chain. Query notes: ID-form grouped query truncates server-side (IncompleteRead); label form returned 421 real rows. Subtype queries are weak: oviDNa label form dies server-side, oviDNb returns 29 weak rows (CB0584 tw=54, foxglove/SEZ/gnathal tw=24) — the aggregate class carries the real signal, per the most-informative-class convention. Skips (documented, not hidden): ontology/transmitter/Notch-hemilineage developmental buckets (GENERIC + SKIP_IDS in build_egglaying.py); optic-lobe-restricted classes (visual neuropil intrinsic FBbt_00059247 — term description states synapses restricted to optic lobes/ocellar ganglia — plus wide-field/narrow-field columnar, medulla intrinsic/columnar, transmedullary) appearing as downstream of SEZ-output/brain classes: class-aggregation artifacts, same family as the proprioception-build incident. INXXX052/INXXX257 are uncharacterized classes (real rows). secondary neuron (FBbt_00047096) is an honest hop-1 terminal (0 rows all forms). CIRCUIT VS DRIVE: every edge is REAL measured wiring of oviDN downstream. The DRIVE DYNAMICS (egg-load-dependent ramping, temporal patterning of deposition) are the genuinely unmapped frontier; no API holds them and this graph models none of them.
